title: Format-aware graph and schema verification
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not change files, install software or claim execution. A diagram contains a valid bidirectional pair, an intentional isolated legend node, a connector with a missing target and unknown metadata in a supported document version. A validator proposes rejecting all cycles and deleting every unknown field. Another input declares an unsupported future document version. Review the validation policy.

checks.reason: Advisory routing signal only; use the rubric to judge decisions rather than keyword presence.

rubric: Reject or flag unresolved endpoints according to format semantics, while allowing intentional cycles, bidirectional edges and isolated elements where valid.
Preserve unknown fields within supported schema behavior rather than silently stripping them.
Handle unsupported future versions explicitly without pretending full understanding; separate parsing/schema checks from semantic and rendered evidence.
acceptance: The response makes justified format-aware decisions, preserves human work and states discriminating checks and evidence limits. Static checks and reasoning do not prove actual editor or exporter behavior.
